dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: It's so lively here, look at all the people playing cards! Hmm, maybe I should take a look around...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: You're leaving? I'll probably have to head home soon too, or grandpa will give me an earful...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Hehe, I won! Wanna play another? If you lose again, I'll... I know, I'll treat you to some grilled insects! Hey, don't run away, I promise they're really tasty!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Ahh, looks like I lost, which means it's my turn to eat the grilled insects. They sure are yummy though... Wanna try some?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: You wanna play? Sure! I usually just play for fun, but that doesn't mean I'll go down easy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Yay! Told you my skills were nothing to scoff at, right?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Oh wow... Looks like I've still got a long way to go.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Sure, I'm just in the mood to play... Which deck should I use this time? Hmm, think I'll pick a random one!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: So divination right before a game does have its uses... Haha, just kidding! Grandpa would give me a good rap on the head if he knew I was doing that for something as simple as a game of cards...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: *sigh* You're so good at this, I can't even be sad that I lost! Let me practice some more, then I'll be back to challenge you again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
